story:
Blackberry Cookie always wears a reserved look, but it would be hard to find a more caring and devoted Cookie.

She has been working at one prestigious household for a long time, and is praised for her miraculous ability to do a multitude of tasks in virtually no time!

Despite Blackberry's tightest schedule, she always finds the time to save the life of her venturesome employer. Perhaps, this is her main duty these days.

costumes.info: A truly spooky, captivating party is held each year on the Night of the Pumpkin Moon! However, many Cookies lose their way before making it there even with their way lit by the large harvest moon. Each of them encounters Blackberry Cookie, who leads them back onto the right path. Don't look too closely at the crowd following behind her, for there may be beings other than Cookies looking back at you.
